gpu_status: User authorized autonomous run launches and as much GPU time as needed on the existing A100. Each experiment still has a fixed scientific stopping rule.
goal: Find a replicable way to predict and explain what a batch update changes; report failures as well as successes.
previous_evidence: Original and confirmation outcomes are completed and inspected. Any reuse is exploratory only.
candidate: Residual-gradient SAE features retaining the inputs that generated each feature
motivation: At a linear layer, the weight gradient is the sum of output-gradient/input outer products. Equal feature totals can induce opposite updates when paired with different inputs.
novelty_status: The outer-product identity is standard. This is a testable extension of the supplied report, not an established novel research contribution.

stages.state: operators implemented; unit and capture tests; no empirical success claim
implemented; awaiting pipeline checks and launch
stages.data: Training and development only; no future final-test examples or outcomes inspected
stages.models: Start with cached Qwen2.5-3B for cost/memory/numerical calibration, then assess Qwen2.5-7B within approved budget
stages.update: One fixed plain linear MLP output module first; stateless SGD. Explicitly narrower than whole-model LoRA training.
stages.capture: True output adjoints and paired inputs at every sequence position, including prompt positions. Preserve per-example mean completion loss and batch averaging.
candidates: SVD reconstruction at matched measured storage

checks: Compare raw reconstruction, update reconstruction, and forecast errors separately

stages.stop_rules: Bounded development budget decided before launch. Retain failed candidates. No searching through future final-test results.
stages.pilot_specification: Two fixed jobs, Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B; seed606; 256 fitting documents, 16 batches, 64 calibration and 64 evaluation questions, one middle-layer MLP output weight; 2x-width TopK SAE, k32, 15 epochs; three fixed step sizes. 12-hour development stop.

requirements: Choose candidate and all parameters using development only
Pin model and dataset revisions; deduplicate all previous study data
Choose primary behavioral endpoint and useful effect-size target before final evaluation
Set sample size, model sizes, independent seeds, exclusions, comparisons, uncertainty method and fixed compute deadline before launch
Use a new untouched test set; save all forecasts and hashes before updates
Finish all planned jobs before outcome analysis; keep failures and incomplete jobs visible
Label features from fitting examples only
Test label predictions on held-out, matched firing and nonfiring examples
Test feature removal against random and norm-matched controls on held-out prompts
Measure generated behavior with locked scorers and blind reviews where appropriate
Do not substitute source-task decoding or reconstruction for behavior-change prediction

loracle_route.constraint: The cached public interpreter uses Qwen3-14B and predicts descriptions/source tasks. It is not a calibrated magnitude predictor for arbitrary Qwen2.5 updates.
loracle_route.next_test: If budget permits, compare descriptions against held-out observed effects with zero/shuffled inputs; fit any numeric readout on separate development updates and evaluate it freshly.

limits: SAEs are also dictionary learning; changing encoders alone does not answer the scientific question
A known-derivative forecast is not new-task transfer
Single-layer effects do not establish whole-model training behavior
Synthetic operator tests are not positive research results
No publication-level result or favorable outcome is promised
